Career Finder continuation coordination — 17 November 2026

Saleh asked this continuation to preserve the original 24-hour boundary, check the restarted Mac and current owners before editing, and avoid a competing editor/build. Source inspection has remained read-only; no build, rerun, merge, push, signing operation or deployment was started here.

## Current ownership and source

- Remote development remains `859b84a4bb184cbc9bb5039be34e35ad4ca17356`; publishing-copy remains `fd9c5399f2b7001b234b3b86bf72e2b36b5114c1`.
- The original owner's native follow-up exists uncommitted in `/workspace/scratch/5bc6158967e8/native-ui-patch-check-859b84a4`. Its main checkout also contains separate unfinished hosted discovery changes. Preserve both.
- Publishing's local checkout `/workspace/scratch/d597fc87411f/career-merge-20261117T0945Z/repo` was observed at `ddc1881a4ec6855854784f581e0b8cb7136bfc11`, newer than the earlier comment's `6066f23c`. Its ancestry includes the Android follow-up `4550b6a` and research commit `24a061daf47d16f0b7ecb5a2ed9f00cd64541ef4`. During this check its Apple environment/UI-test files changed from clean to modified: iPhone work is already active there. This observation is not an ownership transfer or sealed source receipt.
- Desktop Commander lists the Mac online, but the process probe timed out and the session-list request ended with “Timeout - no response from device.” Current Mac processes, locks and dirty files remain unverified. No shared build lock was acquired. Owner-chat navigation was blocked by browser host policy; no direct chat acknowledgment was obtained.
- Keep the established elapsed boundary of **18 November 2026 at 01:26 Riyadh**. The original receipt records the request at 2026-11-16T22:26:12Z and notes that a complete active-work ledger was not recovered. No new clock was started.

## Independent diagnosis and review

Run **44062756461** remains failed on the redesign: Android **92/103 passed, 11 failed**; iPhone UI **14/17 passed, 3 failed**. Both service gates and iPhone logic/unsigned build passed. Android compilation/lint passed; subsequent normal-preview TLS rejection and synthetic native HTTPS phases were not reached.

**Android:** the failures combine English selectors against Arabic copy with a real selected-language/window-context split in nested dialogs. The existing composition-scoped strings fix, localized selectors, and actual rendered Arabic/RTL/text-scale assertions address those mechanisms without dropping state, payload or receipt assertions. The added modal regression makes the expected ordinary inventory 104; this is not a pass claim. Its root RTL assertion does not independently prove modal geometry or TalkBack order.

**iPhone:** the DEBUG availability fixture overwrote `phone-draft.json` on relaunch; seed-once addresses that fixture defect. Search readiness traversed zero-size/stale indexed keyboard keys. The largest-text removal test failed during ordinary-size setup before reaching removal; keyboard dismissal and exact-field input need verification before relaunch. Existing patches retain the relevant persistence, cancellation and keyboard assertions. All 17 cases still require execution.

The original-owner and publishing Apple patches currently differ. Please reconcile them into one candidate rather than layering both helpers. The original owner's `replace` helper also treats text equal to its placeholder as empty, a test-helper edge case not exercised by current fixtures. Preserve exact typed-value assertions and real keyboard hittability.

## Next coordinated gate

Please retain existing development/publishing ownership, acknowledge the integration source here, seal the combined native/hosted candidate and record its full SHA before one CI run. Validate all five jobs on that resulting tree, including the previously unreached Android TLS/HTTPS phases. Earlier green commits do not validate this redesign.

Google configuration is not evidence of a real callback/consent pass. Per-account lifecycle, physical-device/accessibility and signed distribution remain separate pending gates. This review establishes no release-readiness result.

### Native Gemini research review and current CI diagnosis — 17 November 2026

**The actual research has now been read in the native Gemini Mac app.** The two newer responses in “Career Finder Research Plan Review” include a competitor matrix and a ten-entry evidence ledger. A fresh app read at 15:16 Riyadh confirmed the same substantive text. This supersedes the earlier access limitation of the shared web snapshot.

**Publishing is actively testing a newer candidate.** Branch `continuation/publishing-native-fixes-20261117-01a49` is at `cc695391316567288af891f9d2220e6b2d64b0af`, a direct child of combined candidate `59ba784`. It retains the research and earlier native corrections and adds localization for the later Android synthetic-HTTPS phase. [Run 44081037018](https://github.com/swonyu/ahmad-career/actions/runs/44081037018) is the current candidate run. At this check, hosted/storage passed; service, iPhone logic/build and iPhone UI failed; Android remains running. This continuation has not started a competing build or edited an owner's checkout.

#### Immediate owner fixes from the new failure logs

- **Service / synthetic HTTPS:** `website/server-check.mjs:42` receives an empty result after all 77 preceding state groups pass. Its VM context at line 34 omits `TextDecoder` and `TextEncoder`, while the merged bounded body reader in `website/feeds.mjs` now uses them. The resulting reference error is caught as a source failure, obscuring the cause. Supply both standard globals to the test VM; retain the production size bounds and all existing assertions.
- **iPhone logic/build and UI:** `NativeCareerStore.swift:888` exceeds the Swift type-checker's expression budget in the chained ranking/date/title/id sort. Split it into explicitly typed intermediate values and a simple comparator, preserving relevance descending, date descending, title ascending and ID ascending.
- **iPhone UI compilation also fails:** both `NativeCareerViews.swift` sections around lines 756 and 764 combine the titled `Section(...)` initializer with a footer closure. Use explicit content, header and footer closures for **both** sections. The current UI job was cancelled during compilation, so it supplies no 17-test acceptance result.

These are log/source diagnoses, not claims that the proposed corrections have passed.

#### Research reconciliation

WF-01/02/03 already exist in `24a061d` and are inherited by the current candidate. Avoid reapplying them. Two useful, bounded follow-ups remain in the hosted UI:

1. In the existing partial-results warning, retain an explicit stale-results explanation and offer Retry with the last submitted filters even when results are nonempty; preserve edited draft filters and current results.
2. Extend direction isolation to dynamic company/title/file-name/date values in Saved, Apply and secondary dialogs. Search cards already use isolation. Preserve the original stored/exported strings.

Other recommendations need correction before implementation: an all-day iCalendar event may use `DURATION:P1D`; `DTEND` is not mandatory and must not be combined with `DURATION` ([RFC 5545, §3.6.1](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5545#section-3.6.1)). Deterministic UIDs do not establish calendar reimport/update behavior. Preserve existing account/epoch/export guards and quarantined recovery data. Treat JSON Resume as a possible future interchange adapter, not a replacement of the internal profile/revision/PDF approval contract. Do not impose the hosted tab arrangement on the native iPhone app. The competitor sample supports design priorities, not verified market uniqueness; the new ledger contains mixed evidence types, not ten independently verified user reviews.

#### WF-04: a concrete CSV consumer result

Synthetic EN/AR CSVs generated directly from production functions at `59ba784` were imported, saved to XLSX, reopened and saved in the Mac's installed **LibreOffice 26.8.1.1**, with isolated profiles. The newer `cc695391` changes only Android files, so the tested hosted exporter source is inherited.

Arabic, mixed text, emoji, quotes, commas and multiline notes survived. All nine protected formula-like fields remained literal and production sheets contained zero formulas. A separate harmless `=1+1` control evaluated to 2, proving formula evaluation was active.

Standard import coerced numeric-looking free text (`000123`, `1E10`, and a date-like note). A separate import with **quoted fields treated as text** preserved all 63 expected cells exactly in each language, both before and after XLSX reopen/save. In this mode intended date columns also remain text.

This closes only the scoped LibreOffice content/formula/import/reopen checks. Browser download behavior, other spreadsheet consumers, calendar import/reimport, physical devices and accessibility acceptance remain open.

The original **18 November 2026, 01:26 Riyadh** boundary remains unchanged. Preserve the development owner's separate uncommitted hosted discovery patch and both source owners' work; please continue one coordinated correction/run on the current publishing candidate.

### Push coordination and corrected-candidate acceptance — 17 November 2026

Saleh has now explicitly requested **“push everything.”** Preserve and push the original development work and publishing corrections on their respective branches; coordinate the tested integration without replacing either history.

Use ordinary fast-forward pushes and record exact remote heads. Do not replay a completed push/CI relay; keep the next CI dispatch under the active owner's control.

The original development owner has now **pushed `3a709eb15f1024df78ee03474f511568df2dc3de`** to `continuation/account-acceptance-20261117`. [Run 44092957169](https://github.com/swonyu/ahmad-career/actions/runs/44092957169) started on that exact commit. Preserve it alongside the publishing integration. Publishing is at **`5b1493f8584a2d430103bd8a5cf395d53ec111fb`**, already pushed, and is actively correcting two further test issues. **Two owner-initiated runs are now active; do not start another.** This continuation has started no competing edit, push or build.

#### Current run and exact next corrections

[Run 44090269239](https://github.com/swonyu/ahmad-career/actions/runs/44090269239) tests `5b1493f`. At 16:25 Riyadh:

- **Passed:** service/synthetic HTTPS; iPhone logic/unsigned build.
- **Hosted failed:** the language test cleanup hook reported `ENOTEMPTY`. The combined group was 163/164; all seven named language assertions passed. The owner's dirty `hosted/tests/i18n.mjs` correction completes all asynchronous fixture construction before test/teardown registration and preserves the assertions. That correction still needs verification on its committed head.
- **Android failed:** 104/105 ordinary tests passed. `PhoneAcceptanceTest.kt:54` could not find `profile-list` after the direct Profile click at 53. This is **before name entry, save and recreation**, so it does not demonstrate profile data loss. The scrolling-tab change added `revealNavigationTab()`, but this file retained direct navigation clicks. Use that existing real-scroll/visible-tab helper for Profile at 53/66 and Apply/Receipts at 44/47, preserving the Arabic/RTL 180% environment and save/recreate assertions. The owner is now editing this file. The off-viewport explanation is source-supported, without a failure-time screenshot.
- **iPhone UI:** still running. Android's TLS and native HTTPS phases were not reached in this run; the earlier HTTPS timeout correction is not accepted yet.

#### Independent export acceptance completed

Six synthetic calendar files generated by the actual, unchanged `followUpCalendar` at `5b1493f` passed independent **ICAL.js 2.2.1** parsing and serialization/reparse checks. Upstream was pinned to [`277d52c8`](https://github.com/kewisch/ical.js/tree/277d52c8db379f133a88957793e03997a65307f4), with all 23 source/license blob hashes verified; no product dependency, install or build was introduced.

Exact English/Arabic mixed text, emoji, punctuation, escaped newline/backslash, public job URL, all-day DATE/P1D and the correct next day across month-end/leap-day survived. Same-record language/repeat files share UID; changed date or different job has a distinct UID. The deliberate private-note canary, attendees, organizer, alarms and attachments are absent.

This is independent parser acceptance. Actual calendar import/reimport, browser download, native export parity and visual/accessibility acceptance remain open. Prior LibreOffice CSV evidence remains applicable because its exporter/model/catalog bytes are unchanged.

#### Public support copy needs one precise correction

The deployed Pages source `156b3363` applies the hosted five-tab list to both native apps. Replace that navigation sentence in both support languages:

**EN:** On the phone web app, use Search, Saved, Apply, Profile and Settings. In the native iPhone app, use Start, Search, Apply, Saved and Settings; open Profile from Settings. In the native Android app, use Jobs, Apply, Receipts, Profile and Settings. Local profile and saved-opportunity tools do not require an online workspace.

**AR:** في تطبيق الويب على الهاتف، استخدم «البحث» و«المحفوظات» و«التقديم» و«الملف الشخصي» و«الإعدادات». في تطبيق iPhone الأصلي، استخدم «البداية» و«البحث» و«التقديم» و«المحفوظات» و«الإعدادات»؛ وافتح «الملف الشخصي» من «الإعدادات». في تطبيق Android الأصلي، استخدم «الوظائف» و«التقديم» و«إيصالات الإرسال» و«الملف الشخصي» و«الإعدادات». لا تتطلب أدوات الملف الشخصي والفرص المحفوظة محليًا مساحة عمل عبر الإنترنت.
